plan.notes: Source: official SUNY Potsdam 'Transfer Articulation Agreement between Orange County Community College and SUNY Potsdam' (Computer Science A.S. -> Computer Science B.S.), hosted on www.potsdam.edu. This is the ONLY official term-by-term sample sequence SUNY Potsdam publishes for the B.S. in Computer Science; the official academic catalog program pages list degree requirements but no term-by-term sequence. Transcribed 2026-09-30 by direct layout-preserving PDF extraction (pdftotext -layout), cross-checked against the agreement's own printed term totals. STRUCTURE: Years 1-2 are completed at Orange County Community College (OCCC) under the 2+2 agreement; Years 3-4 are completed at SUNY Potsdam. OCCC course codes/titles transcribed verbatim; the agreement's official Potsdam course equivalencies (e.g. CSC 102 = CIS 201, MAT 205 = MATH 151, CIT 225 = CIS 420) are recorded in each mapped course's choice_note. CATALOG YEAR: no explicit catalog year is printed in the agreement; Potsdam's transfer-office filename convention (ORA0712CSBS = Orange, July 2012) dates it to 2012, recorded as 2012-2013. CAVEATS/DISCREPANCIES: (1) The agreement prints 'Total semester hours: (15)' for both Third Year semesters, but lists SIX 3-credit courses in each (18 credits) - an arithmetic error in the official document. This file transcribes the listed courses faithfully (18+18) and totals 136, not the printed 15s. (2) Second Year Second Semester lists 'Electives (recommend SUNY GE-4 or GE-5 gen ed) (2/4)' with a printed term total of (15/17); this file uses the 4-credit option (term = 17) and documents the choice here. (3) The agreement predates the current three-track BS structure (General/Cybersecurity/Data Analytics); the sequence reflects the common core identical to the current catalog's required BS courses (CIS 301/303/310/380/405/410/443/480-490). No prereq information is printed in the source; all prereq lists are empty.
